name: MailPoet
line: WordPress newsletters, marketing automation and site email delivery.

free.text: Free for 500 subscribers and 5,000 emails per month

subs.math: The Business tier for 1,500 subscribers covers 1,000 readers and 4,000 sends a month.
The Business tier for 5,000 subscribers covers 20,000 sends a month.
The Business tier for 10,000 subscribers covers 40,000 sends a month.
The Business tier for 50,000 subscribers covers 200,000 sends a month.

appmail.math: 3,000 WordPress site emails to 500 total recipients. The Starter service fee is $0.
10,000 WordPress site emails to 500 total recipients. The Business 500 service fee applies.
50,000 WordPress site emails to 500 total recipients. The Business 500 service fee applies.
100,000 WordPress site emails to 500 total recipients. The Business 500 service fee applies.
